item.text: I found the main scalability issue: project search currently fetches every project and makes the browser walk them all before showing matches. The acceptance run has accumulated thousands of projects, so I’m moving that substring filter to the API response while keeping its existing ASCII case and whitespace normalization. That should make returning to a searched archived project responsive without changing project order or summaries.

item.text:
Moved project search filtering to the API so the browser creates rows only for matching projects. Matching still trims the query, folds ASCII case, collapses runs of spaces and tabs, preserves creation order, and retains each project’s existing summary.

Verified with `node --check server.js`, `node --check app.js`, and `git diff --check`. Working tree is clean.
